1481.title: In 1481
1481.text: At the death of Mehmed II, conqueror of Constantinople, the empire holds the Balkans and Anatolia.

1520.title: Up to 1520
1520.text: Selim I takes Syria, Egypt and northern Mesopotamia.

1566.title: Up to 1566
1566.text: Under Suleiman the Magnificent: Hungary, Iraq and the North African coast. Several of these regions are tributary states, such as Transylvania or Tripoli.

1683.title: Up to 1683
1683.text: Cyprus, Crete, Podolia and the coasts of Arabia. That year, the failure before Vienna marks the start of the retreat in Europe.

ottoman-empire._note: The outline follows Shepherd's atlas (1923): its limits are approximate, and the map stops south of Egypt and Libya.
